integrity: Analytic proof supplied, accompanied by optional non-certifying finite numerical quadrature diagnostics. Same-model mathematical review only; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotics concern non-tangential approaches to a single straight-sided vertex of a bounded simply connected polygon, for localized nonnegative distance-power symbols and the unweighted analytic Bergman space. The extended Berezin integral need not represent a bounded Toeplitz operator; tangential limits, curved corners and weighted spaces are not covered. Historical priority is conditional on remaining unindexed literature.
title: Sharp corner-power trichotomy for planar Bergman Berezin transforms
